mapper.select: SELECT id, document_code, document_name, document_type, status, created_time, updated_time FROM documents ORDER BY document_code ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO documents (document_code, document_name, document_type, status) VALUES (#{documentCode}, #{documentName}, #{documentType}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, document_code, document_name, document_type, status, created_time, updated_time FROM documents ORDER BY document_code ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id, document_code, document_name, document_type, status, created_time, updated_time FROM documents WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY document_code ASC
